formattedData.title: >_ About Me
formattedData.content:
Hi there! You can call me Photron, a passionate developer
based in London, UK.

I enjoy exploring web technologies, building Discord bots, and
continuously learning new things. Currently, I'm working on
projects like GreenDiningUK, a web application promoting
sustainable dining, and Stingg, a multi-utility Discord bot.

I'm also diving into the world of Data Science, expanding my
skills in data analysis, visualization, and machine learning.

formattedData.title: >_ Contact Information
formattedData.content: Get in touch with me through these platforms:
formattedData.footer:
Feel free to reach out for collaborations, opportunities,
or just to say hello!
